}}'''Feral Sheep''' are the [[Feral Parasites|Feral Version]] of Sheep.
==''Spawning''==
* Spawned when a Sheep is killed by a [[Gnat]] or [[Lice]].
* Spawns from a Sheep succumbing to [[Call Of The Hive]] at [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]] onwards.
* Spawns when an [[Assimilated Sheep]] accumulates a killcount of 60 and [[Evolution System|evolves]].
* Spawns in groups of 4 to 5, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 8|Phase 8]] onwards, with a spawnweight of 25, once 3 Sheep have been assimilated.

==''Behavior''==
Feral Sheep are Melee Combatants.
* Feral Sheep attack through contact damage.
* Feral Sheep can perform small leaps, both on land and in liquids.
* Feral Sheep are able to sink in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
* On hit, Feral Sheep have a chance to drop [[Remains|Feral Remains]].
===''Weaknesses''===
*Feral Sheep, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

=== ''Post Death'' ===

* On death, Feral Sheep have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Feral Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
* On death, Feral Sheep have a chance to drop a [[Gnat]].
